    BEFORE YOU BUILD

    How can we help?

    What you need to take the next step.

    Where is the Concresul plant located?

    Concresul’s concrete plant is located on Estrada PI-22, 3º Distrito, in Piraí, RJ (postal code 27182-000). To ask about delivery, call (24) 3333-2185 or message us on WhatsApp (24) 99985-1277.

    What information do I need to request a quote?

    Start with your name, project city and the service you need. If you know the volume in cubic meters or the planned pour date, include these details in your quote request.

    How do I estimate the cubic meters of concrete I need?

    For a rectangular section, multiply its length, width and thickness in meters. If the thickness is in centimeters, divide it by 100 before multiplying. Use the concrete pour planner for a preliminary estimate. Before placing an order, confirm the quantity with the Concresul team.

    How does stationary concrete pumping work?

    A stationary pump moves concrete through hoses to where it will be placed. Tell us about site access and the approximate distance so our team can assess the setup.

    Does Concresul deliver to my city?

    We are based in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro. Share your jobsite location with us to check whether we deliver there and what delivery requires.
